purpose: Test the observed price-leg loss mechanism by adding actual spot hedges to the previously frozen funding7 short slots. Reuse the same funding hypothesis; this is not a second economically independent alpha or a new OOS claim.
slot_policy: Use only the four negative-weight symbols of each frozen funding7_raw anchor, before looking at spot outcomes. Never replace an unavailable or excluded slot with a later winner, and never redistribute its risk to other slots. Each slot receives at most .0625 NAV spot and the same base quantity short in perpetual. Cold windows reuse their own already frozen initial anchor; continuous anchors preserve original weekly cadence.
spot_domain: First pass covers exact ticker and unit matches only. Explicitly exclude the 1000BONK/1000PEPE/1000SHIB multiplier contracts before any spot financial result; no stripping prefixes or guessed asset aliases. Exact text alone is not identity certification. All other slots require a separately recorded spot/perpetual same-asset identity and episode decision before account execution; unresolved mapping stays unknown and cannot trade.
spot_features: At decision clock use only prior completed spot daily bars in the current approved identity episode. Require 28 consecutive full positive-volume/positive-quote days, arithmetic-valid OHLC and mean daily quote at least10M USDT. Exclude the first observed daily label conservatively. Archive presence today is a source observation, not proof of historical customer tradability. Missing archive or a gap is unknown, not a zero-volume bar or automatic delisting.
funding_entry: Require the original slot to have strictly positive trailing7day funding sum using exact events observable only5minutes after settlement. For the cost-guarded variant additionally require that same trailing7day rate exceed1.25 times the full stress four-leg roundtrip rate .007 (=2*(spot10bps+perp5bps+2*slippage10bps)). No60day extrapolation or annual-yield screen. This is a fixed diagnostic, not a known funding forecast.
review_exit: Weekly whole-book review: unwind a slot that loses membership, fails data/identity/liquidity qualification or has nonpositive known past7day funding; guarded slots also exit below the same fixed cost threshold. Preserve unchanged-slot base quantity without upward rebalance. Replacements enter only after the old slot is fully flat and both wallets permit entry. No synthetic simultaneous fills.
risk_budget: Same initial0.5 gross and70percent segregated futures wallet as the old BTC/ETH carry pilot; not an increase toward the perpetual0.8 budget. Spot assets cannot collateralize the futures wallet during a hold. No short-sale cash proceeds, spot short, borrowing or leverage-up. Missing held prices, unknown held funding cash, episode termination with residual inventory or potential maintenance breach blocks economic qualification.
execution: Acquire actual spot5m and perpetual mark OHLC only after daily feasibility and candidate identity are reviewed. Fill both legs independently using actual next completed5m close, separate1percent actual quote capacity, side-specific slippage, spot-buy base fee and spot-sell quote fee. Queue partial/missing-leg unwind and record failures. Account HWM, risk halt, funding, pending exits and inventory must survive cross-year and actual new-process JSON restoration. Never fill missing bars or assume terminal settlement cash.
capacity_followup: Only marked and closed netPnL positive in continuous608days in both costs and both source variants, no risk/mapping/hedge/terminal unknown, permits100k/1m diagnostics. Module admission still needs cycle/cluster and allocated-sleeve capacity; positive funding attribution alone never triggers admission.
controls: Keep all54 prior sparse accounts and old BTC/ETH carry accounts sealed. Compare matched hedge and unhedged same-window slots as distinct capital/execution paths, not a pure funding counterfactual. Cash and all fees remain explicit. Static allocation/MLP/total-account tests wait for qualified modules.
acceptance: Report net return/CAGR, full-cost closed-cycle win rate and interval, marked/open losses/exit reserves, DD, daily Sharpe, PF, base exposure, basis, segregated collateral, all fees/funding, hedge failures, year/90day/state/covered-event decomposition and capacity. Failure remains failure; few cycles remain unknown. Already viewed2025/26 is diagnostic. Target20percent/30percent applies only to a future multistrategy total account, not this module.
